description: CAW operator guards; merge into the trusted project Codex layer.

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 2; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f "$root/.caw/hooks/deny_tasks_edit.py" || { echo 'CAW edit guard entry point is unavailable' >&2; exit 2; }; python3 "$root/.caw/hooks/deny_tasks_edit.py"
hooks.commandWindows: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or -not (Test-Path "$root/.caw/hooks/deny_tasks_edit.py")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('CAW edit guard entry point is unavailable'); exit 2 }; python3 "$root/.caw/hooks/deny_tasks_edit.py"
